description: Per-prompt-class quality benchmarks across pricing functions and providers: for each kind of request (no text, code, extraction or JSON, multilingual, long form, short factual, general), how good (quality), how fast (p50 and p95 latency) and how cheap (mean cost) each function or provider is. Every cell names its source (simulated bench, recorded bench, or your workspace's own routed calls), its quality metric and its sample size; sources are never mixed. Your workspace's cells appear once a cell has min_events routed calls. Only aggregates: no prompt text is stored. Use it to choose a routing preference or function per kind of request. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope; answers 404 until prompt-class benchmarks are on for your workspace. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

min_events.description: Fewest routed calls a cell of your own needs to be shown.

window_days.description: Days of your routed calls to aggregate.

name: get_prompt_class_benchmarks
